note: Wikimedia Commons, “Евфимий (Кереселидзе). А.П.jpg”; artist as recorded there: უცნობია — fetched 04 October 2026 at 1200px. The licence is as Commons records it. Identified as this saint because: Commons titles it «Евфимий (Кереселидзе)» and describes it «Rev. confessor Evfimy (Kereselizde)» — the surname is the identification, and it is this folder's own Russian name form exactly: days.pravoslavie.ru prints «Евфимий (Кереселидзе), игумен, исповедник, прп.» for 20 January old style, and saint.gr «Όσιος Ευθύμιος εκ Γεωργίας», whose life names him «Ευθύμιος (Κερεσελίντζε)» in brackets. Confessor and Georgian in both, which is the hegumen of Betania and chanter of the Georgian church, reposed 1944. Commons describes it: Rev. confessor Evfimy (Kereselizde).
